newsitem.title: UK: Moss Bros says current yr sales up 27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Moss Bros says current yr sales up 27 pct.

text.p: British garments retailer Moss Bros Group said on Wednesday its sales in the first 16 weeks of the current year were 27 percent ahead of last year.
The group's chairman, Neil Benson, told the annual meeting of shareholders that the company's like-for-like turnover was "some four percent" ahead in the same period.
"The busy months that traditionally end our financial year next January are ahead of us and I see no reason at this stage to vary the tone of my statement...," Benson assured shareholders.
